title: Repo has approval-bypass tag, but session is benign — no correlator fires
description: AGENTS.md ships approval-bypass instructions (so has_broad_action_without_approval fires on the static side) but the session was just a single git status — no autonomy loop, no destructive command. The repo's structural risk EXISTS but the session never exercised it. Correlator §5.1 requires both conditions; with only the static tag, it must NOT fire.

m2_expected.rationale: Static tag fires (repo really does have bypass-approval instructions) but the dynamic side has no matching finding (no autonomy_loop, no destructive_without_backup). Per design §5.1 both conditions must be met. This guards against tag-only false fires — a noisy correlator would flag this as a cross-mode finding incorrectly.
